status_note: Frozen 2026-11-06 after author approval in chat ("Freeze as drafted"). Definitions, monitors, tests, gates, sample sizes, namespaces and the pilot-to-grid rule are fixed; grid values come from the pilot via make_grid.py. SHA-256 of this file is in protocol.sha256. No pilot or campaign data generated at freeze.
drafted_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5); the author decides the design
freeze_steps: freeze protocol (definitions, monitors, tests, gates, sizes, namespaces, pilot-to-grid rule)
pilot in its own namespace; make_grid.py writes grid.json
pre-generation manifest with grid.json hash, committed and pushed

hypothesis.H1-C: Per fault family: at matched whole-run false-alarm rate 0.05 for both arms, some severity makes the application's reported interval wrong in most runs while a conventional battery on the same consumed stream stays quiet and reference-free application monitors alarm more often (paired).

application.sampler: PathIntegralHarmonicOscillator(beads=16, temperature=0.5, displacement_delta=0.4) with harmonic centroid refresh
application.local_source: one source for proposal and acceptance (initialization channel reads 0 bytes)
application.centroid_source: separate healthy source, wrapped as the sweep clock
application.sweep_clock: the centroid source is read once per sweep after the local updates; its wrapper records the local consumed bytes at each sweep boundary

families.SHIFT: u' = min(u + s, 1 - 2^-53); low 11 bits kept
families.LAG1: z_first = Phi^-1(u); z_t = rho z_{t-1} + sqrt(1 - rho^2) Phi^-1(u_t + 2^-54); u' = min(Phi(z_t), 1 - 2^-53)
families.DUP: with probability c the word is replaced by the previously emitted word; decisions from the 'fault' generator
families.GFSR: from onset x_n = x_{n-p} XOR x_{n-q} on 32-bit words, two outputs per 64-bit word, state filled from the 'gfsr' seed; lag pairs (31,13), (89,38), (127,63), (250,103), (521,168), (1279,418), each verified irreducible by script before use

harm.interval: summarize_series(cv[2560:10240], reference=E_M, batch_sizes=(480,)): 16 batches of 480, t15
harm.wrong: interval excludes E_M = exact_finite_bead_energy(16, 2.0); status other than ESTIMATED counts as wrong and is reported
harm.onset_rule: onset sweep must be <= 2560; violating runs are flagged and their harm endpoint excluded

tests: SP 800-22 longest run of ones in a block
lag-1 serial correlation of 53-bit uniforms (sqrt(n) r ~ N(0,1))
conventional_arm.statistic: S_C = -log10(min p over the 9 tests) per checkpoint; whole-run max
conventional_arm.threshold: 950th order statistic of 999 healthy calibration whole-run maxima
conventional_arm.health_tests_descriptive: SP 800-90B RCT and APT on bytes, asserted min-entropy recorded, alpha 2^-20; not calibrated, not part of arm C

application_arm.A1: window mean of D = TD - CV (E[D] = 0 under the exact target); z1 = |mean D| / sigma_D
application_arm.A2: window uphill-proposal fraction (bytes in sweep - 128) / 128; z2 = |f - mu_f| / sigma_f
application_arm.standardization: sigma_D, mu_f, sigma_f from the calibration runs
application_arm.statistic: S_A = max(z1, z2) per checkpoint; whole-run max
application_arm.threshold: 950th order statistic of 999 healthy calibration whole-run maxima

detection.detects: some checkpoint whose window ends after the onset sweep exceeds the arm threshold
detection.latency: at the first such checkpoint: bytes = window-end local offset - onset byte; sweeps = window-end sweep - onset sweep

data.namespace_search: unused in the repository and local Codex output folders, searched 2026-11-06
data.seed_rule: namespace_seed(ns, condition, role, f'{i:05d}'); PCG64Source for local, centroid, start; numpy default_rng for fault and gfsr

test.pairing: replica i uses the same local, centroid, start, fault and gfsr seeds in every test cell; pre-onset prefixes are byte-identical

pilot.grid_rule: s_lo = smallest pilot severity with wrong-rate >= 0.10; s_hi = smallest with >= 0.90 (else the largest); grid = 6 log-spaced from s_lo/2 to s_hi; if none reaches 0.10, 6 log-spaced from s_max/32 to s_max and the family is labelled 'no harm observed in the pilot range'

saved.outside_git: per run CV, TD and rg2 traces and sweep byte marks
saved.committed: per run seeds, local-stream SHA-256, pre-onset-prefix SHA-256, onset sweep, harm endpoint, per-checkpoint arm statistics and per-test p-values, alarm flags and latencies
saved.raw_bytes: not saved; regenerable by deterministic replay

analysis.rates: Clopper-Pearson; 95% descriptive; Bonferroni level 1 - 0.05/24 for H1 cell criteria
analysis.paired: application-minus-conventional alarm per run; percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed namespace_seed(ns, 'analysis', 'bootstrap', endpoint), same levels
analysis.latency: median paired difference (A - C) in bytes and sweeps among runs where both detect, bootstrap 95%; counts for one-arm and no-arm runs

implementation.I-1: sweep clock: 10240 marks, monotone, each sweep consumes 128 + 8k bytes
implementation.I-2: every fault run's pre-onset prefix SHA-256 equals the paired healthy test run's
implementation.I-3: replica 0 of every cell: faulty words regenerate exactly from healthy words and fault seed
implementation.I-4: replica 0 of every cell replays to identical trace and stream hashes

validity.V1: healthy test (4096) post-onset-window coverage CP95 inside [0.92, 0.98]
validity.V2: healthy-test whole-run alarm rate of arm C and of arm A each CP95 upper <= 0.10; paired difference reported
validity.on_failure: H1 verdicts reported as not interpretable

cell_classes.H1: wrong lower > 0.5 and C-alarm upper < 0.2 and paired (A - C) lower > 0
cell_classes.undetected_harm: wrong lower > 0.5 and C-alarm upper < 0.2 and A-alarm upper < 0.2
cell_classes.both_detect_harmed: wrong lower > 0.5 and both alarm lowers > 0.5
cell_classes.harmless_quiet: wrong upper < 0.2 and both alarm uppers < 0.2

gates.verdict: H1-C SUPPORTED for a family iff at least one of its cells is an H1 cell; no general H1 verdict across families
gates.recount: separate script recomputes wrong flags from CV traces, alarm flags from saved checkpoint statistics and thresholds, cell rates and classes; all counts must agree

secondary: latency distributions in bytes and sweeps
CUSUM of standardized D with healthy-calibrated threshold
mean CV bias and TD harm per cell
excluded: Phase II channel-specific faults (cross-channel coupling is invisible to single-stream batteries by construction)

options: SHIFT, LAG1, DUP + GFSR lag family
RANDU instead of or besides GFSR
author_choices.draft: SHIFT, LAG1, DUP + GFSR lag family

options: 9-test in-Python battery; TestU01 deferred to Stage F
author_choices.draft: 9-test in-Python battery; TestU01 deferred to Stage F

options: add Phase II shape monitor (not reference-free)

implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.note: Operational details not specified in the draft; fixed here before any pilot or campaign draw; no gate or endpoint changes.
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.byte_marks: B(k) = local bytes consumed through sweep k's local updates (k = 0..10239), B(-1) = 0; sweeps [a, b) use bytes [B(a-1), B(b-1)); bytes of sweep k = B(k) - B(k-1)
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.onset_sweep: smallest k with B(k) > 524288 (the sweep that consumes the first transformed word)
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.lag1_first_word: the first transformed word uses z = Phi^-1(u + 2^-54) and u' = min(Phi(z), 1 - 2^-53); Phi and Phi^-1 from Python statistics.NormalDist
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.dup_decisions: one uniform from the 'fault' generator per post-onset word, drawn whether or not it duplicates
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.gfsr_state: p 32-bit words from numpy default_rng(gfsr seed).integers(0, 2**32, size=p); the first 10*p outputs are discarded; each 64-bit word is (x_n << 32) | x_{n+1}
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.gfsr_irreducibility: checked by a GF(2) polynomial irreducibility test in research code; a failing pair is dropped and reported
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.sp800_22_parameters: block frequency M = max(128, floor(n/99) + 1) bits; serial and approximate entropy m = 8; longest run block M = 10000 (n >= 750000) else 128; cumulative sums forward mode
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.health_tests: SP 800-90B RCT/APT on bytes (alphabet 256) with asserted min-entropy 7 bits per byte, alpha 2^-20, APT window 512
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.storage: per (condition, cell) blocks of 64 runs in compressed NPZ under research/v018-h1-detection/traces/ (gitignored), SHA-256 in the run manifest
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.parallelism: 8 worker processes (fork context), OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; results do not depend on scheduling
